text:
noah: Quick report — new Next demo-kit (Next + LangChain) is flaky for first-time runs. Repro below, looks like an auth + kv-seed ordering issue. anyone run into this?

kim: which demo? the `next-demo-kit` we shipped last week?

noah: yep. Steps: 1) clone repo, 2) cp .env.example -> .env.local (set REDWOOD_API_KEY and REDWOOD_API_URL), 3) yarn && yarn dev, 4) click 'Start demo' -> UI hangs, server logs show `KV_NOT_FOUND` followed by `401 POST /v1/generate`.

omar: hmm that sounds like the tutorial's seed script (seed-kv) isn't running before the client attempts to mint ephemeral tokens. If the seeded prompt ID is missing the client goes into a retry loop that triggers early auth calls and then 401s.

noah: exact console: `GET /api/seed -> 200`, then `POST /api/auth/ephemeral -> 200`, then immediately `POST /v1/generate -> 401` and client retries.

kim: common pattern — devs click UI before background job completes. Quick fixes: in the starter, block the demo button until seed returns, and add a short client-side wait/retry when 401 happens and seed was just run. Also update README to mention running `yarn seed` before first run.

omar: I'll open a tiny starter PR to gate the UI, call seed from the server on first launch, and add a CI smoke that runs `yarn seed` before playing the demo.

ci-bot: ci-bot: created ticket https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/issues/412 and added a CI step to run the seed script during smoke tests.

noah: thanks — once PRs land i'll re-test and paste logs if anything else pops up. :thumbsup:
